Community Bank N.A. Acquires 1,106 Shares of Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) Posted by Anthony Miller | Jan 30th, 2018 
Community Bank N.A. boosted its position in shares of Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 1.1% during the 3rd quarter, according to its most recent Form 13F filing with the Securities & Exchange Commission. The firm owned 103,294 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after acquiring an additional 1,106 shares during the period. Apple makes up approximately 1.8% of Community Bank N.A.’s holdings, making the stock its 11th largest holding. Community Bank N.A.’s holdings in Apple were worth $15,920,000 at the end of the most recent reporting period. 
A number of other institutional investors and hedge funds have also recently modified their holdings of the stock. Stone House Investment Management LLC now owns 1,570 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $226,000 after purchasing an additional 6 shares during the period. Jackson Grant Investment Advisers Inc. lifted its stake in shares of Apple by 0.3% in the 2nd quarter. Jackson Grant Investment Advisers Inc. now owns 5,431 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $782,000 after purchasing an additional 17 shares during the period. Karp Capital Management Corp increased its position in shares of Apple by 1.6% in the 2nd quarter. Karp Capital Management Corp now owns 1,427 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $206,000 after buying an additional 22 shares in the last quarter. Welch Investments LLC increased its position in shares of Apple by 1.5% in the 2nd quarter. Welch Investments LLC now owns 1,607 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $231,000 after buying an additional 23 shares in the last quarter. Finally, Accurate Investment Solutions Inc. increased its position in shares of Apple by 0.4% in the 2nd quarter. Accurate Investment Solutions Inc. now owns 6,600 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $951,000 after buying an additional 26 shares in the last quarter. A number of analysts recently commented on AAPL shares. Drexel Hamilton restated a “buy” rating and issued a $208.00 price objective on shares of Apple in a research report on Monday, October 9th. UBS Group restated a “buy” rating and issued a $180.00 price objective on shares of Apple in a research report on Monday, October 9th. Vetr cut Apple from a “strong-buy” rating to a “buy” rating and set a $173.47 target price for the company. in a report on Friday, October 6th. Robert W. Baird reiterated a “buy” rating and set a $175.00 target price (up previously from $172.00) on shares of Apple in a report on Wednesday, October 4th. Finally, Piper Jaffray Companies reiterated a “buy” rating and set a $196.00 target price on shares of Apple in a report on Wednesday, October 11th. Two research analysts have rated the stock with a sell rating, twelve have assigned a hold rating, thirty-eight have assigned a buy rating and one has given a strong buy rating to the company’s stock. The stock has a consensus rating of “Buy” and a consensus price target of $201.18. 
Apple Inc. ( AAPL ) traded down $2.11 during midday trading on Tuesday, hitting $165.85. 32,210,308 shares of the company’s stock were exchanged, compared to its average volume of 30,378,439. The company has a market capitalization of $854,400.00, a PE ratio of 18.05, a PEG ratio of 1.39 and a beta of 1.23. Apple Inc. has a 12-month low of $120.62 and a 12-month high of $180.10. The company has a current ratio of 1.28, a quick ratio of 1.23 and a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.73. 
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last posted its earnings results on Thursday, November 2nd. The iPhone maker reported $2.07 earnings per share for the quarter, topping analysts’ consensus estimates of $1.87 by $0.20. The firm had revenue of $52.58 billion for the quarter, compared to analysts’ expectations of $50.71 billion. Apple had a net margin of 21.09% and a return on equity of 36.29%. The company’s revenue was up 12.2% on a year-over-year basis. During the same quarter in the previous year, the firm posted $1.50 earnings per share. analysts expect that Apple Inc. will post 11.17 EPS for the current year. 
In other news, insider Daniel J. Riccio sold 15,641 shares of Apple stock in a transaction on Tuesday, November 14th. The sale was disclosed in a document filed with the SEC, which is available through the SEC website . Also, insider Eduardo H. Cue sold 65,361 shares of Apple stock in a transaction on Thursday, November 30th. The stock was sold at an average price of $171.60, for a total transaction of $11,215,947.60.
